2607.25532.title: Entangled by Design: Spurious Intra-Variable Signal Routing in Tabular In-Context Learners
2607.25532.paper_summary: Consider a model trained at a single hospital to predict patient recovery, where the measured feature $X$ bundles the patient's true health signal ($C$) with a systematic artefact from that hospital's equipment ($S$). Within that hospital, the artefact correlates with outcomes through unmeasured confounders such as patient demographics; an in-context learner rationally routes predictions through $S$, not $C$, and fails silently when deployed at a new hospital with different equipment. We formalise this as \emph{spurious routing in composite representations}: when a feature $X = [C;\,αS;\,η]$ encodes a causal signal $C$ and a spurious signal $S$ in distinct subspaces, the ICL cannot determine which drives predictions. We prove that under ridge ICL, a linear in-context learner, this routing is unavoidable regardless of context size; TabPFN, a state-of-the-art pretrained tabular ICL model, shows qualitatively consistent behaviour empirically. We derive a closed-form characterisation, $\mathrm{CSR} \propto ρ_S/ρ_C$, confirmed at $r = 0.997$ for linear ICL and $r = 0.979$ for TabPFN. Contrary to intuition, larger context sharpens commitment to the dominant in-context signal, amplifying spurious routing by up to $1.74\times$; in the high-spurious corner, more expressive models show greater vulnerability empirically ($+2.22$ CSR gap at high entanglement). We introduce two lightweight mitigations: environment-stratified context construction and S-swap augmentation, that require only weak environment labels and no knowledge of the causal partition. S-swap reduces spurious routing by $74\%$ for linear ICL and $98.8\%$ for TabPFN, with TabPFN's causal sensitivity increasing $8.4\times$ simultaneously: the model does not become agnostic, it reroutes through the causal signal.
2607.25532.paper_summary_zh: 考慮一個在單一醫院訓練的模型，用於預測病人康復，其中測量的特徵 $X$ 將病人的真實健康信號 ($C$) 與該醫院設備的系統性伪影 ($S$) 結合在一起。在該醫院內，伪影通過未測量的混淆變數（如病人的人口統計特徵）與結果相關；一個上下文學習者合理地通過 $S$ 而非 $C$ 來路由預測，並在部署到設備不同的新醫院時默默失敗。我們將此形式化為 \emph{複合表示中的虛假路由}：當特徵 $X = [C;\,αS;\,η]$ 在不同的子空間中編碼因果信號 $C$ 和虛假信號 $S$ 時，ICL 無法判斷哪一個驅動預測。我們證明在脊線性 ICL 下，這種路由是不可避免的，無論上下文大小如何；TabPFN，一個最先進的預訓練表格 ICL 模型，實證上顯示出質量一致的行為。我們推導出一個封閉形式的特徵化，$\mathrm{CSR} \propto ρ_S/ρ_C$，在線性 ICL 中確認為 $r = 0.997$，在 TabPFN 中確認為 $r = 0.979$。與直覺相反，更大的上下文加強了對主導上下文信號的承諾，將虛假路由放大至 $1.74\times$；在高虛假角落，更具表達性的模型在實證上顯示出更大的脆弱性（在高糾纏下，CSR 差距為 $+2.22$）。我們引入了兩種輕量級的緩解措施：環境分層上下文構建和 S-swap 增強，這只需要弱環境標籤且不需要因果劃分的知識。S-swap 對於線性 ICL 減少了 $74\%$ 的虛假路由，對於 TabPFN 減少了 $98.8\%$，同時 TabPFN 的因果敏感性增加了 $8.4\times$：該模型並不變得無知，而是通過因果信號重新路由。
